message.content:
This editorial illustration features a large, green, thick hardbound book being carried on multiple legs. The book is angled, showing its dark green cover, spine, and white pages. A thin red and purple ribbon bookmark extends from the pages. Emerging from beneath the book are six legs: three in dark pants and black shoes, and three in light stockings and high-heeled shoes, with one leg partially obscured by a red skirt. The legs are in a walking motion towards the right. The background is a flat, muted green.

At the top, the red word "TEMPO" is prominent above "ENAK DIBACA". Smaller black text reads "Amburadul Mengurus Satelit H.100" and "Tambang Ilegal Kabupaten Bungo H.90". On the book's cover, white text says: "LOBI PENENTU KUHP BARU", followed by smaller text: "Pemerintah dan DPR tancap gas mengesahkan Kitab Undang-Undang Hukum Pidana yang mengancam demokrasi. Gerilya terakhir anak buah Jokowi. H.32". At the bottom right, white text includes "12-18 DESEMBER 2022", "RP 50.000", "MAJALAH.TEMPO.CO", and a barcode with a QR code.
